title: Understanding Fairness Surrogate Functions in Algorithmic Fairness

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the Difference of Demographic Parity (DDP) between male and female groups in income prediction using the Adult dataset, specifically by comparing various fairness surrogate functions used in logistic regression.
Measuring the Difference of Demographic Parity (DDP) between clients aged 25-60 and other age groups in predicting term deposit subscriptions using the Bank Marketing dataset.
Calculating the Difference of Demographic Parity (DDP) between Caucasian and African-American defendants in recidivism prediction using the COMPAS dataset.
